identity.title: [v0.92][WP-04.16b1.5] Extend authenticated Raft transport to governed learners

review_prompts: Does the private transport::governed subtree make TransportAuthorityOwner construction and every authority mutation reachable only from SecurePolisNetworkFactory, while preserving public distributed learner_transport and polis_runtime source paths?
Are raw QUIC send, receive, learner handshake, permit construction, exclusion activation, flip, expiry, and cut replacement private or opaque so no crate sibling can mint a governed-looking bypass?

Does each ordinary and learner request retain one shared authority lease from under-fence revalidation through stream creation, actual OpenRaft append or snapshot effect, and response send or receive without a dropped gap or nested read deadlock?

Do exclusion, successor flip, expiry, and authority-cut replacement serialize under one lock order, update exact current view and durable truth, drain routes, and make retained sessions fail before any later governed data STREAM?

Does a separate checkpointed random transport instance id survive restart, do canonical peer pins bind role plus stable Raft id plus node and Guardian ids, and do signed handshakes reject a fresh alternate-root peer while accepting a same-root restart?

Does production learner boot attestation require runtime-owned nonclone custody and hold the durable current-generation guard while the nonextractable Guardian signer signs, so retained generation N cannot attest or sign after N plus 1?

Do the untouched distributed_transport and distributed_discovery targets and the distributed_runtime_transport target all compile against the dependency-free transport core and compatible public reexports?
Does real_four_node_learner_replication prove a writer waits across the real learner Raft effect and response while preserving snapshot, append, and unchanged voter behavior?
Does the retained exclusion race prove the in-flight request boundary and zero post-exclusion STREAM frames across every public ordinary dispatch route?

Does v6 evidence distinguish exactly 36 semantic cases from 42 private runner tests, separately require 13 public tests and 29 named subassertions, protect every moved or new path, and bind exact current-main ancestor dbd060d1e?
Are all changes bounded to #202, with #199 promotion and later serving or recovery integration left to their declared owners, and no paid runner, AWS, publish, merge, or closeout side effect?

findings.summary: No learner-owned production factory/transport-instance path exists: factory construction rejects a local node outside the three-voter cut, learner ingress derives the voter identity from fixed self.local, and the real-four-node proof uses one voter factory and test-only boot inputs for both endpoints, so it does not prove distinct durable voter/learner instances, production custody in the handshake, or ingress after leadership moves.

Pending exclusion does not govern recovery learner admission: recovery_learner_allowed has no production caller, factory admission checks only the trusted cut, session currentness checks only admission identity and digests, and the named recovery test invokes the helper directly rather than the factory path.

Exact removal/recovery artifact binding is incomplete: removal activation validates identity and voter-cut digest only, while the authorized deadline and target-membership digest are neither checked against live inputs nor retained for enforcement; activate_pending_exclusion has no current-time or expected-target-membership input.

The v6 receipt is not clean or future-main fail-closed: its protected producer hard-codes all four operator-preserved temporary directory names as cleanliness exceptions, and its validator checks only the recorded ancestor without requiring current origin/main to equal or be ancestral to the proof source.
